title: Agency Partnership Playbook
audience: Independent developers seeking referral and subcontracting relationships with agencies.
shortDescription: Generate referral and subcontracting opportunities from agencies.
coreOutcome: Build and manage a focused agency-partnership channel.
problem: Agency outreach fails when it is generic, poorly timed, or unclear about delivery fit.
situation: You want a relationship-based acquisition channel but do not have a repeatable way to identify and approach compatible agencies.
commonFailure: Pitching every agency the same way ignores capability gaps, timing, trust, and operational fit.
methodology: Identify compatible partners, clarify your role, create a relevant approach, and manage the relationship over time.
whoItsFor: Freelancers and small development teams open to partner delivery
whoItsNotFor: Anyone seeking instant referrals from cold contacts

seo.title: Agency Partnership Playbook | Prospect Foundry
seo.description: Build a deliberate agency referral and subcontracting channel for development work.
